objects.name: RNC Schultzky
objects.infocard: <?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-16"?><RDL><PUSH/><TEXT>The RNC Schultzky was dispatched in an exploratory mission through the Edge Worlds to scout for Nomad presence and to search for badly needed natural resources. After the Nomad war, the Edge Worlds were wide open for exploration and exploitation. The fleet was maneuvered into the gas cloud by the Nomads and cut to pieces. After the devestating tactical, financial, and psychological loss, the Rheinland government cut off all funding for exploration into Omicron space.</TEXT><PARA/><POP/></RDL

objects.name: Battleship LNS Allegheny
objects.infocard: <?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-16"?><RDL><PUSH/><TEXT>The Liberty Battleship Allegheny was dispatched on an ill-fated mission to eradicate the Nomad scourge in Omicron Zeta via a recently discovered jump hole in Alaska. The Liberty Navy felt that the Nomads were just too close to their top-secret 'skunk works' facility in Alaska. Unfortunately the Nomads were just as concerned about a human presence too close to their Dyson Sphere homeworld and placed a large minefield around the hole on their end. The Allegheny jumped into the system and blundered into the mines never to be heard from again.</TEXT><PARA/><PARA/><PARA/><PARA/><POP/></RDL

objects.name: Rhodan's Folly
objects.infocard: <?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-16"?><RDL><PUSH/><TEXT>The Rhodan's Folly was an obsolete freighter that had been impounded by the Bretonia Police during a drug interdiction. When they heard that Bretonia Intelligence was looking for old ships to use on missions they handed over the keys to BI6. The Rhodan's Folly was equipped with a long range sensor suite, powerful new computers to process and interpret information, and outfitted for a six month mission and staffed with a two person crew. BI6 was concerned about reports of increased Nomad activity in the Omicrons and the Rhodan's Folly was dispatched to investigate the Dyson Sphere. A diversion was created to draw any Nomads away from the Dyson Sphere entrance and the Folly slipped inside to take up station there. After no word was heard from the Rhodan's Folly in over a year BI6 declared the ship missing in action and the mission was filed as inconclusive. No rescue or search missions are planned.</TEXT><PARA/><POP/></RDL

objects.name: Fool's Errand
objects.infocard: <?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-16"?><RDL><PUSH/><TEXT>The Fool's Errand is one of several rumored wrecks from a convoy that attempted to find a smuggler's path through the radiation cloud of Epsilon Mu. objects.name: Dead Man's Hand
objects.infocard: <?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-16"?><RDL><PUSH/><TEXT>The wreck of the Dead Man's Hand is one of several rumored wrecks from a convoy that attempted to find a smuggler's path through the radiation cloud of Epsilon Mu. A gambler looking for a quick road to riches, Kendra Rogers boasted that he knew a secret route. The smuggler's convoy hired him to show the way and to provide escort services. Looks like his bluff was called.</TEXT><PARA/><PARA/><PARA/><PARA/><PARA/><POP/></RDL

objects.name: Busted Flush
objects.infocard: <?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-16"?><RDL><PUSH/><TEXT>The Busted Flush is one of several rumored wrecks from a convoy that attempted to find a smuggler's path through the radiation cloud of Epsilon Mu.
